If the candidates are sourced from our internal database, their skills, strengths and weaknesses have already been evaluated and documented in the system providing for rapid response to our clients’ needs.
Our detailed evaluation process begins by reviewing each of the client’s requirements; determining the candidate’s years of experience with each skill; the level of skill that the candidate has with that skill; how, when, and where the candidate achieved that level of skill; and whether or not that candidate has any certifications proving that skill level.
**Methods for Screening and Examples of Criteria Used**
**Application Verification**

Once a qualified candidate is identified, the DSN Talent Sourcing Team begins the verification process to determine the validity of the candidate’s claimed skills and skill levels. In addition to our internal checklists and processes, we use HireRight, a third-party background screening service, to thoroughly verify the candidate’s application details including dates of employment, job titles, responsibilities, attendance, employee rating, reasons for leaving, eligibility for rehire and other information as needed.
In addition, the DSN team will contact any references provided by the candidate and request training credentials and certificates of completion, if available. If the candidate has stated on their resume that they have been certified in any skill by a national or international certification organization, we will verify that the certification was actually issued and whether or not the certification is still valid.
**Initial Pre-Screen Interview**

The DSN Talent Sourcing Team will then conduct an initial pre-screen interview with the candidate by phone or video conference. During this initial evaluation process, we review the candidate’s resume in detail to ensure that each of the client’s requirements is fully met, as well as confirm that the candidate is available and interested in the opportunity.
**Technical Competency Testing**

Once a candidate has passed the initial screening process, the DSN Talent Sourcing Team, led by our Technical Manager, conducts technical competency testing to evaluate the potential candidate’s stated skills. We often utilize third-party online testing resources and/or physical testing facilities such as, Derrico Computers and Software Unlimited, to help evaluate the technical skills of potential hires. During this technical review process, the candidate’s skills are evaluated independently of the recruiting process to provide an unbiased technical opinion of the true skill level of the candidate. DSN is committed to matching resources to <client>’s requirements each step of the way.
**Background Checks**

DSN uses a comprehensive and thorough background check process to qualify personnel prior to any placement or employment. We utilize HireRight for criminal background checks, identity checks, drug screening, I-9, E-Verify, and any other checks as required by the client. We also use Quest Diagnostics and other qualified medical facilities nationwide to conduct drug screening on all employees before the start of their assignment.
**In-Person Interview**

After a candidate and their application documents have been screened and verified, the DSN Talent Sourcing Team will arrange an in-person interview with the Recruiter, Technical Manager, Account Manager and HR Manager.  Each interviewer uses an internal questionnaire document to consistently assess, score and record the candidate’s responses to a standard set of questions. During the in-person interview our team will thoughtfully determine whether the candidate is a good match for the client’s requirements and culture.
**Select Finalists and Support the Selection Process**

Following the screening and interviewing steps, the DSN Talent Sourcing Team meets to compare notes, examine the test results score and decide if the resource meets all client requirements. If the candidate is determined a potential fit, the Account Manager will provide the client with a short-list of the most highly qualified candidates. Clients receive all documentation on the candidate including: resume, application, interview notes, testing scores and background check results.
Prior to onsite engagement, the Account Manager will brief the new hire of the client’s requirements and expectations for the position. DSN believes that proactive communication of responsibilities and intended outputs can help ensure that the resource effectively meets all performance measures.
